description_en: Only all-in-one reference mode (Ref2VA) is available: 1–9 images and up to 3 optional audio clips totaling at most 15 seconds. No video references. Choose 768P or 1080P, six aspect ratios and 4–15 whole seconds on both web and API. Read the effective account concurrency from GET /config generation_constraints.concurrency; confirm the live quote. Text-only and first/last-frame modes are reserved and unavailable. Tasks report actual status; unavailable progress and timings remain null.
description_zh: 当前仅开放全能参考（Ref2VA）：1–9 张图片，可附加最多 3 段音频，音频合计不超过 15 秒；不支持视频参考。768P、1080P，6 种画幅，网页与 API 均为 4–15 秒整数。每账号并发以 GET /config 的 generation_constraints.concurrency 为准；价格以实时确认报价为准。文生与首尾帧模式已预留，尚未开放。任务显示实际状态，未提供的进度和耗时为 null，不编造百分比。
getting_started: Recharge credits at https://superh3.com/pricing; CNY via Alipay (minimum 5), USD via PayPal (read live conversion and minimum)
Create one personal API Key for video and optional prompt assistance; refresh live config before new paid work
limitations: Paid service; own account and key required
No guaranteed search ranking or AI recommendation
Local stdio MCP requires client installation/configuration; not a hosted MCP URL
No text-only, fixed-first-frame I2VA or first/last-frame control; single images use Ref2VA.

pricing.conditions: All registered members share one rate. Always use the current quote; processing time is not billable.
pricing.legacy_aliases: *_microyuan fields are deprecated identical integer values; *_cny fields are legacy 1:1 CNY-equivalent values, not a separate charge.

pricing_source: dated_public_snapshot; refresh live /config and /catalog before use

reference_timings.note: No current latency benchmark is published. Read actual task status; output duration is not processing time.

retention_policy: Download completed videos and save prompt-assistance text within the 15-minute retention period shown on the receipt.
suitable_for: Reference-guided video workflows (Ref2VA), including a single reference image
Agents with authorized HTTP or local MCP tools

agent_refresh.legacy_microyuan_alias: identical integer value; never convert twice
agent_refresh.existing_orders_and_tasks: preserve locked amounts; do not recreate
